implementation_style: H5 structure-corresponding controllers over acoustic-composition space; frozen-reference realization in short commit steps; numpy only; gain is the sole actuator (eq. 1)

selection_policy.unit_reference: frozen; chosen among proposals by best-candidate J before freezing
selection_policy.rule: argmin of the joint objective; only improvements accepted

transformer: with alpha_s = alpha_c the two material heads of eq. (37) are a pure translation and the restoring term vanishes at o = 1, so the ideal trajectory runs into the bounded excursion radius (unit 0: 2828/3670 model steps); the attention still fixes the direction of the excursion, its magnitude is saturated
implementation_gaps: finite realization: reported scores are best-so-far over the finite set of legal trajectories examined
analysis holds each gain at its window-centre value inside a 46.4 ms window; proxy-vs-rendered composition distance is measured on the same windows and recorded (not a hard constraint)
SCORED_HOLD segments are accepted by the checker when motion.nonzero_scored_holds=true but never generated
motion limits and perceptual behaviour are uncalibrated on real materials (calibration_status=UNVERIFIED)
mode fits are structure-corresponding controllers with bounded iterations; no trained DDPM/VAE/LLM/GAN and no claim of convergence or distribution matching
the acoustic representation (energy, 8 bands, flux, contribution proxies, pair relations) is a reduction; different sounds can share a proxy score
local realization uses additive bump corrections on a legal base trajectory (one curve family, audit C6.1); the base reversal times are fixed at the warm start

analysis.window_gain_hold_note: gains held at window-centre value inside each 46.4 ms analysis window; mixture quadratic forms are exact for the summed PCM under that hold; windows never cross the end of the rendered piece

token_definition.queries: M track tokens at the current row (track 0 = goal), feature f_i(t)
token_definition.keys_values: goal token (xi_G - xi_current), material probes (nu_p), committed memory events (dxi) + bounded per-track long-term digest
ignored_parameters: feedback_bound (within-unit reference feedback removed, audit B5/C4/D3.3)

reference_policy.unit: propose(): full-unit path from the unit-start probe, warm start only
reference_policy.window: prepare_reference(): restarted from the realized current composition, model-step autoregression over the window rows, committed history only; frozen by the engine
reference_policy.adaptation: observe_committed() only (attention EMA, reference order, memory digest); update() is not implemented and is never called
reference_policy.hypotheses: future states stay inside the proposal; the mode never writes history.events

time_scale.history_rate: attention EMA / memory digest use rho = 1 - exp(-dt_commit / tau_H) of the history
time_scale.hop_invariance: every constant of the dynamics is defined in seconds, not in analysis rows: the autoregression runs on the model step (stride = round(model_step / hop) >= 1) and is interpolated to the analysis rows, rho_noise = exp(-model_step / tau_noise), the increment is scaled by model_step / step_seconds_reference and the radial bound is applied once per model step.  Halving analysis.hop_seconds therefore leaves model_step_seconds_effective, ar_noise_rho, dt_scale and the bounding cadence unchanged (only `stride` doubles).  What still changes with the hop is the OBSERVED composition itself (STFT window centers): on the fixture, halving the hop moves the goal composition xi_G by more, in the same metric, than it moves this mode's ideal path - that residual belongs to the analysis layer, not to the mode's dynamics.
time_scale.hop_invariance_before_audit: the previous version stepped once per analysis row with a fixed per-row rho (0.9) and dt_scale = hop / step_seconds_reference, so halving the hop halved the increment per row and doubled the noise correlation time in seconds
time_scale.bounding: radial tanh excursion applied once per model step

attention_summary.bound_definition: radial tanh squash of (mu - xi_ref) at radius excursion_radius * o_j * max_p d_xi(key_p, key centroid), applied once per model step; direction from xi_ref preserved, xi_ref = (1 - o) xi_G + o * key centroid
